name: makarasty
description: Two Claude Code plugins: makarasty runs one job across several sessions with evidence gates, makarasty-tools is nine everyday commands for git, review, handoff and notifications.

plugins.name: makarasty
plugins.description: Run one job across several Claude Code sessions: a shared task queue, reports written to files, a frame-count check before every browser observation, and a gate that refuses a fix without a reproduction that failed first. Ten mission kinds, from test sweeps and fixes to refactors, research and design.

plugins.name: makarasty-tools
plugins.description: Nine everyday commands: commit and ship under your own name, review a diff with evidence, hand a chat off before its context runs out, collect bugs until a codeword, explain plainly, strip assistant tics from text, phrase a vendor call in simple English, and get a phone message when a chat finishes.
